newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Sum Cheong takes 2.95 pct Berjaya stake.
newsitem.headline: Sum Cheong takes 2.95 pct Berjaya stake.

text.p: Sum Cheong International Ltd said on Monday its wholly owned Gain Source Ltd had bought 15 million shares, or 2.95 percent, of the existing share capital of Berjaya Industrial Berhad for 45 million ringgit.

Sum Cheong said Gain Source bought the Berjaya shares from third parties at an average of 3.00 ringgit per share, representing a 15.25 percent discount to the closing price of 3.54 ringgit per share on February 13.
The purchase will be funded by internal resources, it said. The value of the stake represents about 18.41 percent of Sum Cheong's net tangible assets as of June 30, 1996.

Berjaya is an investment holding company with interests in eight publicly listed companies in Malaysia, Singapore, the Philippines and Australia. Its businesses include hotel ownership and management, brokerage, shipbuilding and infrastructure construction in the Asia Pacific region.
The market capitalisation of Berjaya was about 1.8 billion ringgit as of February 13.
Sun Cheong is a holding company with units engaged in trading, construction, mining and manufacturing.
